description: Headline status for Workplan v7: report each predicted observable's current error against the 100× experimental target (σ_pred ≤ σ_exp / 100). Audit-only — reads existing witnesses, does not introduce new predictions. All CODATA values + uncertainties source from codata_constants / codata-2022-validation-masses.witness.json / cal-3-q-beta.witness.json — no floating literals.

rows.note: NOT SCORED. q_0 is pinned from m_p/m_e, so this 'prediction' is m_e x (m_p/m_e) re-evaluated through the identity that pinned it — the framework content cancels and the residual is CODATA's own rounding, not accuracy. Reported for round-trip auditing only.

Evaluated at the consistent Two-Term Borromean proton pin q_2t (m_p^QCD(q_2t) + M_p^QED,conn(q_2t) = m_p^CODATA, M_p^QED,conn = +0.220077 keV from QOU.BraidsAndKnots.NucleonWeightSpaceTwoTerm.trace_QAdjp_borromeanV3), which increases q_2t above the 1-term proton pin q_1t by +11.17 ppb and collapses 96.2% of the +211.2 ppb μ-p anchor tension down to +8.058 ppb (+0.37 σ_exp, beating 1× experimental uncertainty). 1-term q_1t baseline (105.658397811 MeV, +211.2 ppb) preserved in one_term_q1t_baseline.

rows.sigma_source: COMPARISON TARGET (codata_MeV), NOT the prediction: m_e × (m_μ/m_e)_CODATA = 0.5109989506900000000000000000000000000000000000000005654434719000544678 × 206.7682827000000000000000000000000000000000000000000223638476790838774 (ratio-derived; independently-quoted 105.6583755(23) MeV). The PREDICTION (pred_MeV) is the INDEPENDENT categorical value m_μ = m_e·Vol(4_1)/ℏ_q² from the Borromean witness — post the 2026-05-29 q₀ re-pin it is a genuine 9.5σ PREDICTION, NOT ratio-derived. The ~210 ppb pred-vs-codata gap (963.6× the 100× target) is the real μ-p tension; m_μ does NOT meet L2. Do not read 'ratio-derived' as 'm_μ trivially meets' (the error PR #1556 made).

two_term_qed_diagnostics.note: Headline m_mu is now scored at the consistent Two-Term proton pin q_2t (+8.058 ppb = +0.37 σ_exp, beating 1× experimental uncertainty; 1-term q_1t baseline +211.2 ppb recorded in one_term_q1t_baseline). Because d ln(m_p^QCD/m_e)/d ln q ≈ −20.997 < 0 and d ln(m_mu/m_e)/d ln q ≈ −20.199 < 0 at q0, subtracting the repulsive connected Borromean V³ proton self-energy M_p^QED,conn = +0.220077 keV (> 0) from m_p^exp lowers m_p^QCD(q_2t) and INCREASES q_2t above q0 by +11.17 ppb (+1.240e-8), collapsing 96.2% of the +211.2 ppb μ-p tension down to +8.058 ppb (+0.37σ; or −14.28 ppb = −0.66σ under Cartan K_p^⊗3 = q0 weighting).

rows.note: CONDITIONAL on three unproved classes (ArchimedeanLimit, BlochSuslinUniqueness, BringZeroModeBlochClass) — a conditional prediction, not a proved derivation. The Schwinger factor is NOT FITTED and this is measured, not asserted: parametrising it as (1 - c*h^2*alpha), the c that hits CODATA exactly is 0.7312340272 and the 1-sigma window is [0.61846303, 0.84400502], so the published c = 1 lies OUTSIDE it, at 2.383 sigma -- a fitter would have taken 0.731. But it is NOT DERIVED either: the exact vertex-moment check (docs/audits/2026-07-14-alpha-em-phase3-schwinger-coefficient-exact-check.md) gives +0.1281 against the claimed -h^2 = -0.0437, wrong order and wrong sign, ratio -2.93, and recommends the tier 'structurally-motivated / empirically-anchored'. That is the honest label. NOTE the residual's SIGN depends on the CODATA edition (the 2018->2022 shift is 2.2x the residual); the reference is read from the registry so the edition is not a choice.

convention_frame_qbeta.cache_note: Convention C (z = sqrt(q)/(1+q)), reached only via --historical-convention-C. C was excised by owner ruling (2026-08-09, re-affirmed 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-26); this artifact is retained because 10 consumers read it, including the L2 dashboard per_observable_100x_status.py. The DEFAULT (convention D) path REFUSES: no D-frame ladder has been derived, so there is no D-frame c_k to emit (bean qou-cds1). Substituting z_D into alpha = (z-1)h/2 is proved invalid by QOU.QBeta.decayLadder_zC_threeRow_ne_zero and QOU.QBeta.eigenphase_bar_defect_of_fullBar.
convention_frame_qbeta.induced_error_unquantifiable_reason: qbeta_ck_cache.py raises SystemExit(2) under convention D ('convention D has no derived c_k ladder'), so no D-frame counterpart of this prediction exists to difference against.
convention_frame_qbeta.scored_rows_note: The Q_beta / m_n / Delta_pn rows published here are built at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) -- the canonical convention -- on the base the owner ruled 2026-09-08, re-scored 2026-09-12. They do NOT consume this C cache, so this block records the cache's frame and is NOT a caveat on those rows. What IS open is that no c_k ladder exists on an admissible base (qou-cds1); see qbeta_ruled_base.ladder_on_admissible_base_exists.

functional_admissibility_qbeta.note: STRONGER THAN THE CONVENTION-FRAME NOTE, AND SEPARATE FROM IT. That note says the c_k LADDER is convention-C. This says the BASE the ladder sits on uses a functional convention D provably excludes: the published closed form solves to z = 1, which is not a root of the (1^3) weight numerator. The best ADMISSIBLE cell is +12.47% (the augmentation on Delta_S) against the published 0.16776%, and the RULED cell is -43.157% -- the ruled cell is the FARTHEST of the three from CODATA, which is the anti-fit directive working as designed, not a defect in the ruling. WHICH FUNCTIONAL TO ADOPT IS NO LONGER OPEN: the owner ruled 2026-09-08 that eps is the Markov trace at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) (convention D, two-row truncation, D7), and authorised the dashboard re-score on 2026-09-12 with its price measured first (qbeta/qbeta-zd-rescore-price.witness.json). The Q_beta row is scored on the ruled base from that date, so this field records the admissibility EVIDENCE rather than a live defect -- it becomes the live warning again only if the re-score's calibration against this witness fails. Do NOT relate any cell to the ~1279 ppb the retired row used to show: that was post-ladder, and no ladder has been derived on an admissible base (qou-cds1, blocked on the phase qou-pdix), so what the ruled base would become with one is UNKNOWN. Applies to the m_n and Delta_pn rows, which are derived from this value -- and unlike the convention note, it is written ONTO those rows rather than cross-referenced from this one.
